name: Dexterra Group Inc.
summary: Dexterra Group Inc. engages in the provision of support services for the creation, management, and operation of infrastructure in Canada. It operates through two segments, Support Services and Asset Based Services. The Support Services segment delivers a suite of operation, maintenance, and hospitality solutions for a diverse range of public and private sector clients, including remote operations, governments, aviation, education, industrial, transit, healthcare, and leisure. The Asset Based Services segment provides workforce accommodation structures, access solutions, and space rentals to clients in the natural resources and infrastructure sectors.
